 ONLY ONE PROJECT PER TEAM
 Eligibility
 Open to high school students worldwide (ages ~13–19).
 Teams may consist of 1–4 participants.
 Participants must join the official Discord for updates and workshops.
 Must choose a track and category
 Prizes
 Prizes will be awarded:
 1st, 2nd, 3rd in each track
 2 Honorable Mentions in each category (1 per track, if not in top 3)
 Best Presentation/Pitch Award
 Judging Criteria and Winner Selection
 Projects will be judged on the following equally weighted categories (25% each):
 Innovation & Creativity 
 How original is the idea?
 Does it present a novel approach or perspective?
 Impact & Relevance 
 Does the project address a real-world problem?
 Could it make a meaningful difference if developed further?
 Execution & Technical Quality 
 Coding Track → Is the solution functional, technically sound, and well-documented?
 Research Track → Is the research thorough, logical, and well-supported by evidence?
 Presentation & Communication 
 Is the problem and solution clearly explained?
 Does the video/demo effectively showcase the project?
 Is the pitch engaging and professional?
 Judges will consist of industry professionals, researchers, and educators .
 In case of a tie, the Impact & Relevance score will serve as the tiebreaker.
 General Rules: 
 Treat all of your fellow competitors with respect and integrity 
 Do not attempt to cheat or steal other’s projects in any way 
 Cross posting and using previously made projects
 Do your best to create a new original project, but previously made ones are fine but will recieve deductions 
 Cross-posting is allowed 
 No non-original work can be submitted 
 Non-original work will be disqualified  
 Usage of outside resources for documentation and reference purposes is permitted 
 AI Guidelines 
 The use of AI in the development of your projects is permitted 
 However, keep in mind quality of your product is considered
